summary: I am Luiz Felipe dos Santos, a junior full stack developer who works mainly on the frontend, and a Multiplatform Software Development student at Fatec. I work with React, TypeScript and Node.js building web applications, with experience in REST API integration, SQL/NoSQL databases and agile methodologies. Here you will find my background, projects and technical skills.

availability.label: Looking for new projects and jobs

aboutParagraphs: I am a junior full stack developer, mainly focused on frontend, at InCicle, where I work on product modules of a micro frontend architecture, from implementing new features to evolving versions of existing modules. I use React, TypeScript and Node.js across the full cycle, from gathering rules with the product team to deploying to production. I study Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec, in the 6th semester; it was at Etec that I had my first contact with programming.

I like to understand the context of each delivery before implementing it and to discuss business rules with the people who define the product. I use Artificial Intelligence tools in my development workflow to keep the quality and organization of what I deliver. I learn by doing, on projects both at work and outside it.
workPrinciples: I discuss the rules with the PO before implementing, instead of just following what is written in the task
I break large features into smaller parts before starting
I write the test before the code and put what I deliver through a review before opening the PR
